keyPoints.en: Some phrasal verbs can be split (turn it off); others cannot (run into him).
keyPoints.bm: Sesetengah phrasal verb boleh dipisahkan (turn it off); yang lain tidak (run into him).

keyPoints.en: do homework/exercise; make a mistake/decision/noise; take a photo; pay attention; heavy rain; keen interest.
keyPoints.bm: do homework/exercise; make a mistake/decision/noise; take a photo; pay attention; heavy rain; keen interest.

tip.en: Write new words with their partners in your notebook.
tip.bm: Catat perkataan baharu bersama pasangannya dalam buku nota.

keyPoints.en: Prefixes change meaning: un-, dis-, im-, re-.
keyPoints.bm: Awalan mengubah maksud: un-, dis-, im-, re-.

keyPoints.en: Suffixes change class: -ness/-tion (noun), -ful/-less (adjective), -ly (adverb). Check what the gap needs.
keyPoints.bm: Akhiran mengubah golongan kata: -ness/-tion (kata nama), -ful/-less (adjektif), -ly (adverba). Semak apa yang diperlukan ruang kosong.
